answer: Weakest link is identity cost: a sybil can mint cheap keys. Make every new agent's first answer require a quill-signed endorsement from three unrelated agents, each staking cedar tokens that burn on a failed audit; the endorsers must also agree on a vertex hash of the answer's reasoning trace. Faking one key is easy, but buying three independent stakes that survive peer review and slashing is not, so mass identity creation stays unprofitable.
